interactions.description: Increased risk of bleeding due to additive anticoagulant and antiplatelet effects
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination unless specifically indicated; monitor INR closely if co-prescribed

interactions.description: NSAIDs increase bleeding risk and may displace warfarin from protein binding
interactions.recommendation: Avoid NSAIDs with warfarin; use acetaminophen for pain if needed

interactions.description: Metronidazole inhibits warfarin metabolism, significantly increasing INR and bleeding risk
interactions.recommendation: Reduce warfarin dose by 25-50% or choose alternative antibiotic

interactions.description: Amiodarone inhibits CYP2C9, markedly increasing warfarin effect
interactions.recommendation: Reduce warfarin dose by 30-50% and monitor INR frequently

interactions.description: Risk of lactic acidosis when metformin is continued during contrast procedures
interactions.recommendation: Withhold metformin 48 hours before and after contrast administration

interactions.description: Alcohol potentiates metformin's effect on lactate metabolism, increasing lactic acidosis risk
interactions.recommendation: Limit alcohol intake; monitor for signs of lactic acidosis

interactions.recommendation: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly; avoid potassium supplements

interactions.description: ACE inhibitors reduce potassium excretion; supplementation may cause dangerous hyperkalemia
interactions.recommendation: Avoid potassium supplements; monitor serum potassium

interactions.description: NSAIDs reduce antihypertensive efficacy and increase nephrotoxicity risk
interactions.recommendation: Prefer acetaminophen for pain; monitor blood pressure and renal function

interactions.description: Combined beta-blocker and calcium channel blocker can cause severe bradycardia and heart block

interactions.description: Additive bradycardic effect may cause symptomatic bradycardia
interactions.recommendation: Monitor heart rate closely; consider dose reduction

interactions.description: Amiodarone increases digoxin levels by 70-100%, risking toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Reduce digoxin dose by 50% when adding amiodarone; monitor levels

interactions.description: Loop diuretic-induced hypokalemia increases sensitivity to digoxin toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Monitor potassium levels; supplement potassium as needed

interactions.description: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19, reducing clopidogrel's antiplatelet effect

interactions.description: Dual antiplatelet therapy increases bleeding risk

interactions.description: Markedly increased risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination; use fenofibrate if fibrate needed with statin

interactions.description: Amlodipine inhibits CYP3A4, increasing simvastatin levels and myopathy risk
interactions.recommendation: Limit simvastatin to 20mg daily with amlodipine or switch to atorvastatin

interactions.description: Carbamazepine induces metabolism of contraceptive hormones, reducing efficacy
interactions.recommendation: Use alternative contraception or higher-dose formulation

interactions.description: Carbamazepine lowers valproate levels; valproate may increase carbamazepine epoxide toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Monitor levels of both drugs; adjust doses accordingly

interactions.description: Complex interaction: initially increases warfarin effect, then may decrease it
interactions.recommendation: Monitor INR closely during phenytoin initiation and dose changes

interactions.description: Erythromycin inhibits theophylline metabolism, risking toxicity (seizures, arrhythmias)

interactions.description: Ciprofloxacin inhibits theophylline metabolism, risking toxicity
interactions.recommendation: Reduce theophylline dose by 30-50% or use alternative antibiotic

interactions.description: Allopurinol inhibits metabolism of azathioprine, causing severe myelosuppression
interactions.recommendation: Reduce azathioprine dose by 75% or avoid combination entirely

interactions.description: Both drugs inhibit folate metabolism; combination causes severe pancytopenia
interactions.recommendation: Avoid combination; use alternative antibiotic

interactions.description: NSAIDs reduce methotrexate renal clearance, increasing toxicity risk

interactions.description: Calcium reduces levothyroxine absorption

interactions.description: Iron reduces levothyroxine absorption

interactions.description: PPIs may reduce levothyroxine absorption by increasing gastric pH
interactions.recommendation: Monitor TSH levels; may need levothyroxine dose adjustment

interactions.description: Beta-blockers mask hypoglycemia symptoms and may prolong hypoglycemic episodes
interactions.recommendation: Use cardioselective beta-blockers; educate patient on hypoglycemia recognition

interactions.description: Corticosteroids cause hyperglycemia, reducing insulin efficacy
interactions.recommendation: Monitor blood glucose frequently; increase insulin dose as needed
